description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language model services, with event handling for client connections.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including event handling.

classes.name: OpenPipeLLMService
classes.description: Language model service via OpenPipe API.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts run_bot.
